videos.title: At Home With Jim and Joy
videos.description: Dynamic husband and wife radio team Jim and Joy Pinto bring their powerful witness to daytime TV with special guests and topics focusing on marriage, family and pro-life issues.

videos.description: Bluegrass band The Hillbilly Thomists, composed of Dominican friars, played in concert at the historic Lyric Theater in downtown Birmingham.
